newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent quoted down, short covering to support.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent quoted down, short covering to support.

text.p: April Brent crude futures were untraded and indicated lower in late afternoon dealings in Asia on Monday, marked lower after the fall through the $20.00 support.
April was quoted at $19.74/$19.78 per barrel after London fell 29 cents to $19.79 on Friday -- giving up major support at $20.00 on the way.
Brokers said short covering would offer support on Monday, but $20.00 would now represents strong resistance on the upside potential.
